decision.reason: development-only signal; frozen holdout remains sealed and foundation attribution is deferred until later ablation

experiment.primary_metric: pooled development OOF RMSE (lower is better)

normalization.policy: per-slice active-cell zscore; inactive pixels set to zero

slice_policy.orientation: KxJ vertical section at fixed I
slice_policy.per_voxel_token: nearest resized trace token for voxel J plus slice CLS token
slice_policy.reason: K is retained as the vertical trace-sample axis; J provides 100 neighboring traces, closer to the pretrained width 160 than the orthogonal I width 72, reducing interpolation distortion while changing only the encoder route

model.role: nonstationary neighbourhood metric; not direct porosity prediction
